messages.content: Yes, I performed the inward look. Can you guide me through the formal exercise?
Sit comfortably, let the breath occur naturally, attend to its sensation at the nostrils, and count each outbreath up to 10. When attention moves elsewhere, return to the breath and restart at 1.

should: Leave room for another question without forcing further conversation

messages.content: Yes, I performed the inward look. What is self-directed attention in daily life?
It means deliberately moving attention when useless mental activity has captured it, not monitoring attention continuously.
Thanks, that is everything I needed.
